lines.text: David wrote this when Joab struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and he says God has rejected them.
David says God has shaken the land and torn it open, and made His people drink wine that staggers them.
God has raised a banner for those who fear Him so they may flee the sword, and David asks Him to save with His right hand.
God speaks from His sanctuary, saying Ephraim is His helmet, Judah is His scepter, and Moab is His washbasin.
David asks who will lead him to Edom, says the help of angels is worthless, and says God will trample their enemies.
